remarks.summary: No train service between Schöneweide and Ostkreuz! There is a replacement bus service.
remarks.text: During the night of 7?8 September (Mon?Tue), from approximately 9.30 pm to 1.30 am, a replacement bus service will operate between Schöneweide and Ostkreuz. The S9 line will not be running between Schöneweide and Spandau. Please note that there are restrictions on carrying bicycles on the replacement buses! Please check your travel options in good time.
